New UI: src/app/(app)/soil-sample/[fieldId]/ (SoilSamplePageClient.tsx -- pick zone -> GPS-guided RECORD CORE loop, reusing LocationTrackingProvider/NetworkStateProvider/pause/resume/finish/confirm exactly as ActiveJobSessionView.tsx already does -- one new UI for a new activity type, not a second GPS architecture), entry point added to FieldDrawer.tsx's Soil tab ('Start soil sample', alongside the pre-existing 'Add or review soil tests').
